brief: Find the official local source for a deadline or filing obligation instead of importing another country’s rule.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Official Rules"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Usa la regla oficial pertinente"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Use a regra oficial pertinente"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Find the official local source for a deadline or filing obligation instead of importing another country’s rule.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A deadline from another country or year can lead you to the wrong action.
instruction.misconception: A familiar foreign deadline or a popular post establishes the current local filing obligation.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Tax obligations depend on jurisdiction and circumstances. Consult the relevant official authority for the current period and your case.
The relevant authority and period match the question.
Another country’s deadline does not establish the local one.
An official source can still refer to the wrong period.
Official rules can apply only to specified categories.
Independent access avoids relying on a possibly false message.
A cross-border case needs relevant official or qualified local guidance.
